tenderSchedule.locationName: HGML Sr Manager Met Section Hutti

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
The firm must be registered in India with appropriate tax and other administrative authorities.
As the Government of India has implemented Goods and Service Tax (GST) from 1st July 2017, Hence Bidders are required to quote accordingly in lieu of Taxes, Duties etc.
Bidder shall give undertaking that they have accepted our terms regarding Delivery/Completion, Validity & Payment as per format enclosed.
The document submitted by bidder in kpp portal shall not be in corrupted/damaged/protected format.
The payment and validity period in technical bid B & D should be same.
Bidders shall upload all the Documents in PDF format only.
Other terms and conditions are as per NIT clause and any pre-counter terms and conditions will not be accepted.
If price bid is submitted in technical bid, then EMD will be FORFEITED and your offer will be REJECTED.
All other terms and conditions as per the NIT.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The chemist / firm must have the work experience in running of retail pharmacies attached to a hospital owned by Government (Central or State) / Public/Private or Autonomous bodies etc. with a minimum of 100 beds for a period of minimum 2 years.
The bidder must be registered, licensed, experienced and reputed pharmacy license holder/ chemist
The bidder must be in possession of valid drug License as per Drugs & Cosmetics Act, 1940, as amended from time to time and Rules made there under (for existing establishments).

The bidder shall possess a valid ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System issued by a certification body accredited by NABCB (National Accreditation Board for Certification Bodies) or equivalent accreditation body that is signatory to the IAF MLA. The certificate shall be valid as on the date of bid submission.
The chemist must not have been convicted by the State Drugs Authorities and no case should be pending under the Drugs & Cosmetics Act 1940 and rules made there under.

The bidder must have GST registration number, PAN number, EPF and ESI registration numbers. a. The successful bidder i.e license shall maintain the records relating to payment of wages, remittances of b. EPF and ESI and produce to the HGML as and when required by the HGML.

The bidder should have achieved average annual turnover of Rupees Three Crores per annum during last three preceding financial years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25. Relevant documents certified by the Chartered Account shall be uploaded.

The bidder should neither have been blacklisted by any central/state government department/PSUs in the last three years (Since April 2022) nor should have any litigation pending with any of these departments.
Income Tax Returns for the last three years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 shall be enclosed to the technical bid.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate, Profit & Loss statement and Balance sheet issued by the chartered Accountant for the year FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Copies of ITR for the last three years i.e. FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Copies of Purchase Order/Completion Certificate/Satisfactory report as a proof for past experience
Duly filled technical bid B should be attached in Technical Bid and format can be downloaded from enclosure
Undertaking as per Technical D should be attached and document can be downloaded from enclosures.
